variables.name: ECID
variables.description: Experience Cloud ID assigned by AEP Web SDK; primary cross-session visitor identifier.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full URL of the page the hit was fired on.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / brand identifier for cross-report-suite roll-up.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Data collection environment used to isolate production from dev/stage traffic; drives the Production Data Only segment.

variables.name: Marketing Channel
variables.description: Marketing channel attributed via Marketing Channel Processing Rules (rules defined separately).

variables.name: Login / Registration Status
variables.description: Registration/authentication state of the visitor; supports optional-registration tracking where unregistered visitors retain full access.

variables.name: Hashed Visitor ID
variables.description: [Hashed — PII] Registered visitor identifier, SHA-256 hashed in JS before entering the data layer; ties email-verified registration to profile.

variables.name: Student Cohort Flag
variables.description: Derived student-cohort indicator from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source; not stored as permanent PII, refreshed annually.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name for all tagged pages.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section for content grouping (programme, venue, trails, info, etc.).

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Page template/type; distinguishes venue detail vs venue listing, programme listing, privacy, terms, cookie policy, etc.

variables.name: Brand Compliance Flag
variables.description: Indicates whether the page conforms to Heritage SG brand guidelines as tagged by the content model.

variables.name: Government Disclaimer Present
variables.description: Flags presence of the standard government disclaimer on the page.

variables.name: Programme / Installation ID
variables.description: Unique ID of the festival programme or installation displayed or interacted with.

variables.name: Programme / Installation Title
variables.description: Display title of the programme or installation.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme/installation or venue page.

variables.name: First Festival Year
variables.description: Optional firstFestivalYear field from the AEMaaCS content model for the programme/installation.

variables.name: Unlocked Content State
variables.description: Whether optional unlocked content is present and whether it is visible to the (scanned-in) visitor.

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA
variables.description: Context of the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action click (which programme/venue the CTA was on).

variables.name: Trail ID
variables.description: Identifier of the curated self-guided trail selected, saved or followed.

variables.name: Itinerary ID
variables.description: Identifier of the custom itinerary created, shared, viewed or adopted.

variables.name: Itinerary Share Method
variables.description: Native device share channel used to share an itinerary (no social OAuth).

variables.name: Community Picks Status
variables.description: Whether an itinerary qualifies as a Community Pick (≥10 unique festival-window adoptions).

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
variables.description: Type of inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (dismissible, non-blocking).

variables.name: QR Check-in Context
variables.description: Installation ID / context captured on a QR scan check-in recorded against the visitor profile.

variables.name: Newsletter Topic
variables.description: Topic the visitor subscribed to on newsletter sign-up form submission.

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: The moment/context that triggered the registration prompt (QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile, etc.); supports funnel-by-trigger reporting.

variables.name: Consent Tier State
variables.description: State of the three-tier consent model (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB) captured at registration.

variables.name: Consent Action
variables.description: Consent action recorded in the consent log (grant/withdraw) for a given tier, effective immediately.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Category
variables.description: Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting).

variables.name: Map Interaction Type
variables.description: Type of interaction with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct MapBox map (pin tap, zoom, directions, etc.).

variables.name: Location Permission State
variables.description: Whether location permission was granted (enables proximity sorting) or denied (default listing behaviour).

variables.name: Derived Zone Label
variables.description: Client-side derived zone label passed to Adobe Target; raw GPS is never stored server-side.

variables.name: Crowd Density Level
variables.description: Live per-venue crowd density indicator level derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data.

variables.name: Personalisation Use Case
variables.description: Adobe Target personalisation use case served (your picks tonight, trending with your circle, returning-visitor banner, etc.).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Intent
variables.description: Visitor intent classified by Adobe Brand Concierge (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general festival info).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
variables.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction for engagement/escalation/failure reporting.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL captured for PathFinder pathing analysis. Mirrors the Page URL eVar.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / site identifier. Mirrors the Business Unit eVar for ClickMap/PatternMatch grouping.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name. Mirrors the Page Name eVar; enables PathFinder page-flow reports.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section (Programme, Installations, Venues, Trails, Info). Mirrors the Site Section eVar; supports PathFinder section-to-section flow (BRD 104).

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Page template type distinguishing venue detail vs. venue listing and programme vs. installation pages. Mirrors the Page Type eVar (BRD 104).

variables.name: Programme / Installation Name
variables.description: Title of the festival programme or installation being viewed. Mirrors the Programme / Installation Name eVar; enables PathFinder content pathing (BRD 104).

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Name of the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct venue associated with the page or map interaction. Mirrors the Venue Name eVar; supports ClickMap on the interactive map (BRD 401).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail presented or followed. Mirrors the Trail Name eVar; enables PathFinder trail-step flow (BRD 501).

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: Context that triggered the registration prompt (QR scan, itinerary save, trail follow, newsletter). Mirrors the Registration Trigger Moment eVar; supports funnel-by-trigger PathFinder analysis (BRD 1205).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent
variables.description: Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general info). Mirrors the Brand Concierge Query Intent eVar; enables PatternMatch on intent strings (BRD 1406).

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Baseline custom page view counter fired on every page load. Mirrors OOTB page views for custom reporting and funnel segmentation. Supports BRD 101/103 universal page tagging.

variables.name: Page Load Time
variables.description: Baseline page load time in milliseconds. Pairs with Page Load Time Instances to enable the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric. Supports BRD 1503/1504 Core Web Vitals / performance targets.

variables.name: Page Load Time Instances
variables.description: Baseline counter of page load time measurement instances. Denominator for the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric paired with event2. Supports BRD 1503/1504.

variables.name: Registration Verified
variables.description: Fires when a visitor's email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Registration funnel completion metric. Supports BRD 201/202 and registration funnel reporting (1205).

variables.name: Registration Flow Start
variables.description: Fires when a visitor begins the mobile-optimised email registration flow. Registration funnel entry metric paired with Registration Verified. Supports BRD 202/1205.

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0/1/2) at registration via positive action on an unchecked-by-default checkbox. Consent tier dimension carried in a companion eVar. Supports BRD 301/302 and consent funnel/tier distribution reporting (1204/1205).

variables.name: Consent Withdrawn
variables.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws a consent tier via self-service profile settings, effective immediately. Feeds the consent log and tier-distribution reporting. Supports BRD 303/304/1204.

variables.name: Newsletter Sign-up
variables.description: Fires on newsletter sign-up form submission. Subscribed topic carried in a companion eVar. Supports BRD 1950 engagement tracking.

variables.name: Programme Detail View
variables.description: Fires on display of a festival programme or installation detail page (title, description, venue, dates, times). Distinguished from venue listing via a companion page-type eVar. Supports BRD 104.

variables.name: Ticketing CTA Click
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. Exit/outbound-intent metric; no ticketing is built on the SNF site. Supports BRD 105.

variables.name: Privacy Policy View
variables.description: Fires on a Privacy Policy page view documenting PDPA data collection, purpose, retention and visitor rights. Supports BRD 107.

variables.name: Terms of Use View
variables.description: Fires on a Terms of Use page view. Supports BRD 108.

variables.name: Cookie Policy View
variables.description: Fires on a Cookie Policy page view documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention. Supports BRD 1812.

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct MapBox map (pan, zoom, pin select) showing programme and installation locations. Supports BRD 401/402 and map interaction reporting (1201).

variables.name: Location Permission Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only; only a derived zone label is passed. Supports BRD 403/404/1802.

variables.name: Trail View
variables.description: Fires on presentation of a curated self-guided trail for selection and navigation. Trail name carried in a companion eVar. Supports BRD 501.

variables.name: Trail Saved
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves and starts following a trail. Progress is tracked via QR check-ins. Supports BRD 502.

variables.name: Itinerary Item Added
variables.description: Fires when a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503 itinerary creation.

variables.name: Optimisation Suggestion Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion surfaces on detected itinerary conflicts or inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social OAuth). Supports BRD 505/705.

variables.name: Itinerary Adopted
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (viewable without authentication), which triggers a light registration prompt. Unique festival-window adoptions feed the Community Picks threshold. Supports BRD 506/507/705.

variables.name: QR Scan Check-in
variables.description: Fires when a visitor scans a unique installation/programme QR code, loading the detail page and (for registered visitors) recording a confirmed check-in. Installation ID and timestamp carried in companion dimensions; check-in derived from QR only, never GPS. Supports BRD 601/602/604/1803.

variables.name: Registration Prompt Shown
variables.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is shown on the first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor. Registration-trigger-moment metric feeding funnel-by-trigger reporting. Supports BRD 603/1205.

variables.name: Unlocked Content View
variables.description: Fires when optional unlocked content (visible only to physically scanned-in visitors) is displayed. No empty state when absent. Supports BRD 605/602/1104.

variables.name: Picks Tonight Impression
variables.description: Fires when the bookmark-based 'Your picks tonight' feed with up to 3 affinity-matched recommendations is shown to a registered visitor. Supports BRD 702/706 personalisation and Target reporting (1203).

variables.name: Trending Chip Impression
variables.description: Fires when the 'Trending with your circle' chip (session-hash clustering on shared programmes viewed/bookmarked in the same loop) is shown. Supports BRD 703/706.

variables.name: Returning Banner Impression
variables.description: Fires when a returning visitor is shown the contextual banner for unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops linking to the remaining itinerary. Supports BRD 704/706.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
variables.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge interaction (query sent). Query intent carried in a companion eVar. Engagement-rate numerator. Available to all visitors regardless of registration. Supports BRD 1405/1406.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Escalation
variables.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve the visitor intent. Escalation/failure-rate numerator for Concierge reporting. Supports BRD 1406.

metrics_segments.name: Production Data Only
metrics_segments.description: Isolates production report-suite traffic (Environment eVar = 'production'); applied to all reporting to exclude dev/staging hits.

metrics_segments.name: Bounce Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: percentage of single-hit visits with no onward interaction.

metrics_segments.name: Conversion Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: ratio of a success event to visits, used across funnel reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Pages per Visit
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: average page views per visit, engagement baseline.

metrics_segments.name: All Visits
metrics_segments.description: OOTB visit count metric used as the denominator for engagement and funnel rates.

metrics_segments.name: New Visitors
metrics_segments.description: OOTB metric: count of first-time visitors derived from the AEP Web SDK visitor profile.

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors
metrics_segments.description: OOTB metric: count of returning visitors, underpinning returning-visitor personalisation banners.

metrics_segments.name: Authenticated Users
metrics_segments.description: OOTB metric: count of visitors in an authenticated (email-verified registered) state.

metrics_segments.name: Registered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: email-registration verified visitors (registration status = registered). Supports registered-visitor reporting and personalisation.

metrics_segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors with no verified registration, confirming unrestricted content access for unregistered users.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors who granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent, for consent-tier distribution reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors who granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent, for consent-tier distribution reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Student Cohort (Derived)
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: derived student-cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source; not stored as permanent PII.

metrics_segments.name: QR Checked-in Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors with ≥1 confirmed QR check-in event recorded against their profile.

metrics_segments.name: Trail Followers
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: registered visitors who saved and followed a trail with progress tracked via QR check-ins.

metrics_segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
metrics_segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations.

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Share Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits containing a native-device itinerary share action.

metrics_segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits where a shared itinerary was adopted via one-tap adoption triggering the light registration prompt.

metrics_segments.name: Newsletter Sign-up Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits with a newsletter sign-up form submission, usable by subscribed topic.

metrics_segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits containing a click on the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action.

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Engagers
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits that engaged with the Adobe Brand Concierge assistant, for engagement/intent/escalation reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Granted Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits where location permission was granted, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings.

events.description: Fires on a Terms of Use page view. Supports BRD 108.

events.name: Cookie Policy View
events.description: Fires on a Cookie Policy page view documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention. Supports BRD 1812.

events.name: Map Interaction
events.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct MapBox map (pan, zoom, pin select) showing programme and installation locations. Supports BRD 401/402 and map interaction reporting (1201).

events.name: Location Permission Granted
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only; only a derived zone label is passed. Supports BRD 403/404/1802.

events.name: Trail View
events.description: Fires on presentation of a curated self-guided trail for selection and navigation. Trail name carried in a companion eVar. Supports BRD 501.

events.name: Trail Saved
events.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves and starts following a trail. Progress is tracked via QR check-ins. Supports BRD 502.

events.name: Itinerary Item Added
events.description: Fires when a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503 itinerary creation.

events.name: Optimisation Suggestion Shown
events.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion surfaces on detected itinerary conflicts or inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

events.name: Itinerary Shared
events.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social OAuth). Supports BRD 505/705.

events.name: Itinerary Adopted
events.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (viewable without authentication), which triggers a light registration prompt. Unique festival-window adoptions feed the Community Picks threshold. Supports BRD 506/507/705.

events.name: QR Scan Check-in
events.description: Fires when a visitor scans a unique installation/programme QR code, loading the detail page and (for registered visitors) recording a confirmed check-in. Installation ID and timestamp carried in companion dimensions; check-in derived from QR only, never GPS. Supports BRD 601/602/604/1803.

events.name: Registration Prompt Shown
events.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is shown on the first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor. Registration-trigger-moment metric feeding funnel-by-trigger reporting. Supports BRD 603/1205.

events.name: Unlocked Content View
events.description: Fires when optional unlocked content (visible only to physically scanned-in visitors) is displayed. No empty state when absent. Supports BRD 605/602/1104.

events.name: Picks Tonight Impression
events.description: Fires when the bookmark-based 'Your picks tonight' feed with up to 3 affinity-matched recommendations is shown to a registered visitor. Supports BRD 702/706 personalisation and Target reporting (1203).

events.name: Trending Chip Impression
events.description: Fires when the 'Trending with your circle' chip (session-hash clustering on shared programmes viewed/bookmarked in the same loop) is shown. Supports BRD 703/706.

events.name: Returning Banner Impression
events.description: Fires when a returning visitor is shown the contextual banner for unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops linking to the remaining itinerary. Supports BRD 704/706.

events.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
events.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge interaction (query sent). Query intent carried in a companion eVar. Engagement-rate numerator. Available to all visitors regardless of registration. Supports BRD 1405/1406.

events.name: Brand Concierge Escalation
events.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve the visitor intent. Escalation/failure-rate numerator for Concierge reporting. Supports BRD 1406.

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Isolates production report-suite traffic (Environment eVar = 'production'); applied to all reporting to exclude dev/staging hits.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: percentage of single-hit visits with no onward interaction.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: ratio of a success event to visits, used across funnel reporting.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: average page views per visit, engagement baseline.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: OOTB visit count metric used as the denominator for engagement and funnel rates.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: OOTB metric: count of first-time visitors derived from the AEP Web SDK visitor profile.

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: OOTB metric: count of returning visitors, underpinning returning-visitor personalisation banners.

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: OOTB metric: count of visitors in an authenticated (email-verified registered) state.

segments.name: Registered Visitors
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: email-registration verified visitors (registration status = registered). Supports registered-visitor reporting and personalisation.

segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors with no verified registration, confirming unrestricted content access for unregistered users.

segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors who granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent, for consent-tier distribution reporting.

segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors who granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent, for consent-tier distribution reporting.

segments.name: Student Cohort (Derived)
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: derived student-cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source; not stored as permanent PII.

segments.name: QR Checked-in Visitors
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors with ≥1 confirmed QR check-in event recorded against their profile.

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: registered visitors who saved and followed a trail with progress tracked via QR check-ins.

segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment: visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations.

segments.name: Itinerary Share Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits containing a native-device itinerary share action.

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits where a shared itinerary was adopted via one-tap adoption triggering the light registration prompt.

segments.name: Newsletter Sign-up Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits with a newsletter sign-up form submission, usable by subscribed topic.

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits containing a click on the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action.

segments.name: Brand Concierge Engagers
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits that engaged with the Adobe Brand Concierge assistant, for engagement/intent/escalation reporting.

segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

segments.name: Location Permission Granted Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment: visits where location permission was granted, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings.
